mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and stimulating economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 3.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.0% signals a tightening labor market, strengthening corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE falls below 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand and economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through stronger corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are rising, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising > 0.25 percentage points over 3 months), S&P 500 forward returns become negative over the next 20 trading days due to higher discount rates and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC for the tightening cycle condition is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong economic activity, supporting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 2000.0 thousand units signals a weakening housing market, reducing consumer confidence and economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST falls below 2000.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rises in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signal dual stress on labor market conditions and monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced economic growth and higher borrowing costs.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both UNRATE and FEDFUNDS are rising, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 above 11000 billion and RSAFS above 340000 million), S&P 500 forward returns become negative over the next 20 trading days due to elevated valuations and anticipation of monetary tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 > 11000 and RSAFS > 340000, or the Rank IC for the late-cycle condition is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
